US-0608.pdfName: Ohio River Islands National Wildlife Refuge

notes.t: BOAT ACCESS ONLY. Kentucky part: Manchester 1 Island (20 acres) and Manchester 2 Island (94 acres), Ohio River mile 395. Nearest public ramp: Manchester, Ohio (Island Creek, SR 52). Watch for steep banks and rock dikes when landing.
Open 1 hour before sunrise to 1 hour after sunset. No camping, fires or overnight mooring. Kentucky hunting seasons apply. The refuge spans PA, WV, OH and KY, so it is not an ATNO for most hunters.
1 KDFWR access site — see KPC map file

Ramp + fishing pier on Beaver Lake Rd (KY 749), 7 mi W of Lawrenceburg. Not the Beaver Lake pits on Peabody WMA. Private boat docks/shoreline permits exist on department lakes, so some shoreline is next to private lots: set up at the ramp, pier or public parking.
2 KDFWR access sites — see KPC map file

Two small lakes (Old and New Kingfisher) at Maceo, US 60 E of Owensboro, Hwy 405. No gas motors. Right next door to Carpenters Lake. Private boat docks/shoreline permits exist on department lakes, so some shoreline is next to private lots: set up at the ramp, pier or public parking.
Kingfisher Lakes and Carpenters Lake sit side by side at Maceo: they touch, they do not overlap, so they are not a 2-fer.
3 KDFWR access sites — see KPC map file

KDFWR calls it Carpenter Lake. Ramp, fishing pier and jetty at Maceo (Hwy 405). No gas motors. Next door to Kingfisher Lakes: if both become parks they would only touch, not overlap, so not a 2-fer. Private boat docks/shoreline permits exist on department lakes, so some shoreline is next to private lots: set up at the ramp, pier or public parking.
Kingfisher Lakes and Carpenters Lake sit side by side at Maceo: they touch, they do not overlap, so they are not a 2-fer.

Guist Creek Marina (concession) has the ramp; also a free bank-fishing lot at the Benson Pike bridge. State-record saugeye lake. Private boat docks/shoreline permits exist on department lakes, so some shoreline is next to private lots: set up at the ramp, pier or public parking.

wildIntro.mapSub: Nine state-designated Wild River corridors (official KY GIS outlines, simplified). Tap a number to open that river’s details.
wildIntro.detailsText: Kentucky Wild Rivers are state-designated corridors managed with landowners and agencies. The state layer lists public access as “Restricted” for all nine — much of the land is private. Check each official page for access and parking before you go.
